description: List point-in-time condition assessments recorded against assets. Filter by asset, assessor, method, condition score range, or assessment date range. Condition scores are 0-100: 85+ Excellent, 70-84 Good, 55-69 Fair, 40-54 Poor, below 40 Critical. Amounts are bare numbers with no currency: call get_organization_settings for currency_code before stating one.

page.description: Page number (default: all pages fetched automatically)

per_page.description: Items per page (default: 1000, max: 1000). All pages are fetched automatically.

name: list_asset_condition_assessments
title: List asset condition assessments
